title: dinebra ligulata
intro: Dinebra ligulata, commonly known as False Buttonbush, is a plant species in the family Poaceae. The health benefits of Dinebra ligulata include its potential use in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dinebra ligulata include its ability to soothe and calm the respiratory system, making it a potential natural remedy for respiratory disorders. Bioactive constituents of Dinebra ligulata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
